name: Singapore Cricket Club
summary: Padang-side historic club with cricket, rugby, hockey and other sport sections — a facilities-plus-league alternative when Reclub pickup is not enough.
body: SCC sits on the Padang with cricket, rugby, hockey and a CBD-adjacent social life. Different proposition from family suburban clubs and from free Reclub pickleball: stronger for organised sport sections and central networking once you already want membership structure. Understand category rules and section fees before treating it as a first-week belonging experiment — most newcomers should try hobby sports communities first. Member networks and junior sections can seed teen shadow days and family belonging outside school walls — pair with teen internship guidance and CCA realism.
membershipNotes: Sport-section culture is strong; understand category rules and whether your sport has waiting or playing standards.
